publishedSpecifications.label: meta description
publishedSpecifications.text: This stunning New American farmhouse offers 2,668 square feet of living space, four bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a spacious three-car side-entry garage.The welcoming front porch leads into an elegant foyer featuring an eleven-foot tray ceiling that sets a sophisticated tone for the home.The heart of the residence is an open-concept living area where vaulted ceilings crown both the kitchen and living room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere for daily life.A split-bedroom layout ensures maximum privacy, positioning the primary suite away from the three secondary bedrooms to create a peaceful personal retreat.Dedicated spaces including a formal dining room and a private library or study provide flexible options for remote work or hosting special occasions.Spacious front and rear porches offer a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor living, perfect for enjoying quiet mornings or evening relaxation.Thoughtful functional design includes a large walk-in pantry and a dedicated mudroom to keep the household organized and efficient.
